page.notes: The Arabic and Persian words in the text and notes are transcribed with [?] because the scan is small and the letters are hard to read exactly; the Arabic glosses may need checking against the original. The asterisk note in the left margin is the Arabic "الصلاح والفساد" (good and evil). The left margin note "Abulfed. in" with its Arabic word and "Ine. de opinionibus Arabum." sits beside the "Keblam" line. The word "plo" at the foot is a catchword completing "Tem-plo" on the next page. No signature is visible. Hyphenation "opinio-nibus" and "Redi-tum" are kept as printed.
